subject: maths
book: Mathematics, Open Basic Education Level B (English medium), NIOS

lessons.title: Numbers
covers: Read and write numbers from 1001 to 1,00,00,000 in digits and words
Place value and expanded form of numerals
Compare numbers and order them, ascending and descending
Make the smallest and greatest four-digit numbers from given digits

lessons.title: Addition, subtraction, multiplication and division
covers: Add and subtract larger numbers
Multiply and divide by numbers up to three digits
Estimate products and quotients and check them by working them out
Solve everyday problems with the four operations

lessons.title: Fractions
covers: Understand fractions through pictures
Find equivalent fractions and write fractions in lowest terms
Compare and order fractions
Convert mixed and improper fractions, and add, subtract, multiply and divide fractions

lessons.title: Decimals
covers: Write tenths, hundredths and thousandths as decimals, and back
Compare and order decimals
Add, subtract, multiply and divide decimals by whole numbers
Percent as a fraction out of 100, and converting between decimals and percent
Measurement units (length, weight, volume, time, temperature, rupees) and converting between them

lessons.title: Perimeter, area and volume
covers: Find the perimeter of plane figures
Find the area of plane figures
Find the volume of solid figures
Use these in everyday tasks such as fencing, tiling and filling containers

lessons.title: Geometry
covers: Recognise symmetry and symmetrical shapes
Lines, line segments and rays
Acute, right and obtuse angles; measure and draw angles with a protractor
Draw a circle with and without a compass; name its centre, radius, diameter and circumference
Recognise parallel and perpendicular lines around us

lessons.title: Data handling
covers: What data are and why we need them
Ways to collect data
Read and understand data shown in graphs

gaps: The book has no module grouping; all seven lessons sit under one group.
The measurement section (its heading is numbered 5, around book pages 111 to 117) falls inside the Decimals lesson pages, so it is listed under lesson 4.
Lessons 5 to 7 were checked from the 'From this lesson' lists only; lesson 2 has a long multi-part section which was not read in full.
